sram8t_bitcell_um2.label: projected

mom_cap_density_fF_per_um2.label: derived

Lit. cross-check: FinFET-node MOM 2-4 fF/um2 (projected)

unit_cap_min_fF.label: projected

cap_match_sigma_pct_at_1fF.label: projected
